card.name: Time spans in dosing instructions
card.fires_on: The word "time" in "at any time", the word "over" before an infusion duration, and the "4" in "24 hours/weeks", all inside dosing and administration text.

modes.label: "at any time"
modes.description: The word "time" after "at any" in schedule instructions.
modes.example: and at any<< time>> for visual symptoms.

modes.label: "over" before duration
modes.description: "over" introducing how long an infusion or withdrawal lasts.
modes.example: administered by intravenous infusion<< over>> 60 minutes.

modes.label: The 4 in 24
modes.description: The digit 4 completing "24" before hours or weeks.
modes.example: Administer approximately 2<<4>> hours after cytotoxic chemotherapy.
